propositions: A new read-only reader derives gate-economics and env-diagnosis metrics from existing gate sidecars, writing nothing.
llm_calls and latency cost derivations read the metrics block from REVIEW_RESULT (plan_review_result_v2) only, since COMPLETION_VERDICT records carry no metrics.

cost_per_accepted_change divides summed REVIEW_RESULT llm_calls by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None (Unavailable) when there are zero accepted closes to avoid division by zero.
first_pass_verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first by filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1.
env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR with the next PASS for the SAME gate field on the ticket stream, treating an ERROR with no following same-gate PASS as an open interval.
The reader uses a single raw ordered scan of REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT event files instead of schema-guarded helpers, and registers metrics as authoritative source=sidecar.
